nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor; used as the sole privileged account for delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and as a whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spend allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Total token supply, minted entirely to the deployer in the constructor.
Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist flag; ensure() returns true immediately for any address flagged true and _mints() sets it true.
Address of an extra whitelisted trading venue, also accepted by ensure(); settable only by owner.
Upper bound on how many times a single address may sell; configured by init().
Minimum sale amount in token units; configured by init().
Maximum sale amount in token units; configured by init().
Mapping(address=>uint) counting how many sell operations an address has performed; incremented in transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address; drives transfer ownership checks, allowance spending, and every owner-only gate.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core sell path: spends allowance, calls ensure() (owner/whitelist bypass), then mutates balances with unchecked subtraction and addition and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no checks.
Internal whitelist gate; computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor and returns true for owner, UNI, tradeAddress, the pool, or canSale addresses, otherwise defers to condition().
Internal sell-limit checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum to restrict sales.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata.
Privileged minting/whitelisting function restricted to owner or a hardcoded magic address; overwrites balanceOf[spender] and sets canSale[spender].
Owner-only sale configuration that writes _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only bulk transfer; computes total = _value * _tos.length and mutates balances in a loop with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 pair address derivation using the factory and init code hash.
Deployment constructor: mints total supply to msg.sender, sets owner, and approves the router for uint(-1).
Arbitrary delegatecall executed in the contract storage context, allowing full storage takeover by the owner-controlled target.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath, leaving an unchecked integer subtraction.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath; can overflow a recipient balance accumulated past 2**256-1.
total = _value * _tos.length and the loop balance updates use unchecked arithmetic on user-controlled inputs.
Centralized single-owner authorisation gate reused across privileged functions, including the delegatecall entry point.
Destination address of transfer().
Amount moved by transfer/transferFrom; flows directly into unchecked balance arithmetic.
Source address of transferFrom(); drives allowance, ensure, balance and _onSaleNum logic.
Spender address approved in approve().
Target contract address for the delegatecall in delegate().
Raw calldata payload for the delegatecall in delegate().
Address whose balance is overwritten and whitelisted in _mints().
Balance value assigned to the target in _mints().
Sale count limit written to _saleNum by init().
Minimum sale amount written to _minSale by init().
Maximum sale amount written to _maxSale by init().
Recipient array of batchSend(); its length multiplies the per-recipient value.
New whitelisted trade address written by setTradeAddress().
Supply multiplier used by the constructor to mint the initial total supply.
Token name assigned in the constructor.
Token symbol assigned in the constructor.
total = _value * _tos.length computed in batchSend without overflow protection.
Loop index over the recipient array in batchSend.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address compared against _from inside ensure().

edges.reason: transfer() derives the sender for the token movement directly from msg.sender.
msg.sender controls the allowance spender branch and the ensure() whitelist evaluation in transferFrom.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller directly.
delegate() authorises solely on require(msg.sender == owner) before performing a delegatecall.
_mints() grants minting and whitelisting privileges based on msg.sender equality with owner or a hardcoded address.
init() gates sale configuration on require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() gates bulk token distribution on require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() gates the whitelist slot update on require(msg.sender == owner).
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the deployer.
transfer() delegates its entire behaviour to transferFrom().
transfer ultimately mutates the balanceOf mapping through transferFrom.
transferFrom() requires ensure() to pass before updating balances.
transferFrom subtracts from balanceOf[_from] and adds to balanceOf[_to] with raw operators.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every sell, enforcing per-address sell limits.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is an unchecked subtraction guarded only by a prior require.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is an unchecked addition that can silently overflow.
approve() writes the allowance mapping.
ensure() falls back to condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair address via pairFor() to build its whitelist.
ensure() returns true immediately when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure() grants a bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() grants a bypass when _from equals tradeAddress.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether sell limits apply.
condition() compares _value against _minSale.
condition() compares _value against _maxSale.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
delegate() checks msg.sender against the privileged owner storage slot.
delegate() performs an arbitrary delegatecall that executes untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
delegate() is protected only by the centralized single-owner require gate.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*(10**decimals).
_mints() marks the target address as sellable via canSale[spender] = true.
_mints() relies on a hardcoded privileged address comparison rather than a configurable role.
init() writes the _saleNum state variable.
init() writes the _minSale state variable.
init() writes the _maxSale state variable.
init() is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() debits balanceOf[msg.sender] by total and credits balanceOf[_to] in a loop without SafeMath.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length and per-recipient credits with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend() is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist slot used by ensure().
setTradeAddress() relies on the same centralized owner-only require gate.
The constructor initialises owner with the deployer address.
The constructor assigns the entire initial supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor pre-approves the Uniswap router with uint(-1) allowance.
The constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
The _to parameter selects the transfer recipient.
The _value parameter feeds directly into unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balanceOf[_from] subtraction.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balanceOf[_to] addition.
The _from parameter indexes allowance, balanceOf, ensure and _onSaleNum.
The _spender parameter is the write index of the allowance mapping in approve().
The a parameter is the unrestricted target of the delegatecall.
The b parameter is the unrestricted calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
The spender parameter is the address whose balance is overwritten and whitelisted.
addedValue directly overwrites the target balance in _mints().
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init().
token is scaled into _minSale by init().
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale by init().
_tos.length multiplies the per-recipient value, amplifying any overflow in batchSend.
addr is written into the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
_supply defines the constructor mint amount.
_name is stored as the token name in the constructor.
_symbol is stored as the token symbol in the constructor.
local_total aggregates the unchecked multiplication and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
local_i drives the unbounded recipient loop in batchSend.
local__UNI holds the derived pair address compared against _from in ensure().

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a stage-local argument only consumed by transfer() when it forwards to transferFrom.
_value lives only in the transferFrom sell path and is the operand of the unchecked balance arithmetic.
_from is only meaningful inside transferFrom where it indexes allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum.
_spender is a transient index used solely when approve() writes the allowance mapping.
a is the target address consumed directly by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
b is the raw calldata consumed directly by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
spender is only used inside _mints to overwrite a balance and set the canSale flag.
addedValue is immediately folded into balanceOf[spender] inside _mints.
saleNum is a configuration argument written straight into the _saleNum state variable.
token is a configuration argument scaled into the _minSale state variable.
maxToken is a configuration argument scaled into the _maxSale state variable.
_tos exists only as the loop source of batchSend and its length multiplies the value.
addr is a single-purpose setter argument stored into tradeAddress.
_supply is used only once during deployment to mint the initial total supply.
_name is consumed only by the constructor to set the token name.
_symbol is consumed only by the constructor to set the token symbol.
total is a transient accumulator inside batchSend that is never persisted.
i is the ephemeral loop counter of batchSend's recipient iteration.
_UNI is a transient computed pair address used only for the whitelist check in ensure.
